[[File:Confuse icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Confuse''' is a low-level [[Magic]] [[spell]]. When cast on an opponent, their [[Attack]] level is reduced by 5%. The spell gives [[experience]] whether it hits or misses, making it a popular way to gain experience cheaply. The spell can only be cast if an opponent's stats haven't already been lowered, meaning you can not stack stat-reduction with multiple spells in a row.

The spell grants 13 Magic experience and requires three [[Water rune|water]], two [[Earth rune|earth]], and one [[body rune]] in order to be cast.
